newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil will not change CVRD auction date - BNDES.
newsitem.headline: Brazil will not change CVRD auction date - BNDES.

text.p: The vice president of Brazil's National Development Bank said a high court injunction against the government would not delay the April 29 auction date of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce.
Speaking to reporters, Jose Pio Borges said the court injunction issued earlier on Tuesday did not question CVRD's mining rights but only the property and the use of land above ground.
"We will appeal this decision, but it does not affect the auction scheduled for April 29," Borges told reporters.
He said the court order did not affect the economic value of CVRD's mining and exploration rights.
Borges said that, under Brazilian legislation, a company is entitled to explore and mine in a given area, even if the property and the right to use the land above ground belongs to a third party.
Borges said he was confident the CVRD April 29 auction would be maintained and that more than 60 lawsuits filed against the sale did not pose a threat to its privatization.

Earlier on Tuesday Supreme Federal Tribunal Justice Marco Aurelio de Mello suspended the March 6 presidential concession of virtually all 411,000 hectares of the Carajas iron mine, the world's largest, to Vale do Rio Doce.

In comments to reporters Mello said his injunction would not oblige the government to suspend the privatization auction, but suggested it would make it pointless. ((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
